actual_generation_provenance.actual_prompt:
Create a complete new conceptual illustration, including all labels, for a Chinese semiconductor engineering report. Subject: making the DUT and NEMU use the same startup input resolves an earlier startup mismatch. This is an explanatory concept, not a timing schematic, numeric chart or new verification record. The design must have a visibly new composition compared with a conventional left/right pair of chip-and-document cartoons.

Art direction: polished technical publication with white paper background, graphite #242424 lettering and routes, warm gray #E8E3DC structural areas and a very restrained vermilion #CE4B32 accent. Pale warm #F6F3EE may be used inside structural bands, not as a full-page cream wash. Flat crisp shapes, thin consistent lines, square or very slightly rounded corners, thoughtful alignment, no gradients, shadows, texture, gloss, 3D objects, chip icons, folded-paper icons, computers, magnifying glasses, gears, decorative logos or dashboard cards. Use color for a meaningful relation rather than decoration. Large readable medium-weight Chinese sans-serif, strong but calm hierarchy. Landscape composition around 3:2, comfortably occupying the useful canvas without vast unused borders. No oversized headline or figure title.

Compose TWO broad horizontal comparison bands, one above the other, separated by a fine light gray rule. In the upper band, place the small section label 各自默认 at the left/top edge. Show TWO genuinely separate startup-input rectangles in the left portion, vertically stacked, each labeled 默认启动. Each input has exactly one short rightward arrow to its own execution rectangle in the middle: upper rectangle RTL, lower rectangle NEMU. The two input rectangles may have subtly different neutral fills so they are visibly separate sources. RTL and NEMU execution rectangles must have the same size, same fill and same typographic weight. Their two outputs independently converge into one compact right-hand comparison area labeled 启动差异. Use a restrained broken/jogged comparison motif there if useful, not a giant red cross, not an invented trace or data values. No path runs from RTL into NEMU.

In the lower band, place the small section label 共同输入 at the left/top edge. Replace the two independent source rectangles with ONE wider rectangle labeled 共享启动. Its single source forks into TWO clear arrowheaded paths to two vertically stacked, equal-weight execution rectangles labeled RTL and NEMU. Each model's output independently reaches a compact right-hand comparison area labeled 比较恢复. Use the single vermilion accent primarily on the shared input and its fanout, with restrained accent emphasis at the restored comparison. Do not use green PASS badges or checkmark trophies. Make the visual change from two unrelated inputs above to one common input below the primary graphic story. Avoid any empty repeated blocks or miniature decorative marks that could be mistaken for pipeline stages or samples. Keep all arrows continuous and unambiguous, away from text.

Allowed labels only, exactly with the repetitions described: upper-band 各自默认, 默认启动, 默认启动, RTL, NEMU, 启动差异; lower-band 共同输入, 共享启动, RTL, NEMU, 比较恢复. All labels must be clearly readable at 160 mm print width: aim for approximately 50–58 pixel type at 1536-pixel canvas width, and keep the smallest labels nearly as large as the main ones. Do not fill the figure with prose. No title, figure number, version, bit width, cycle count, startup-byte count, register values, result counts, SHA, measured performance or invented technical text. Exact historical evidence belongs in the report caption. The figure conveys a historical configuration comparison and does not claim any new test was run.
actual_generation_provenance.note: Actual built-in whole-image result for S1-07. Warm direction chosen provisionally by the root after three design comparisons; this is not human approval or a new engineering run.

review.acceptance_criterion: A clearly different, readable and professional whole-image concept candidate for historical startup-input unification, with meaningful graphics rather than a prose-filled panel; no exact timing/data or new test claim.
review.evidence: Viewed the actual built-in output. The upper band visibly has two separate startup sources, each entering only its own RTL/NEMU model, then a startup-difference comparison. The lower band has one orange shared source fanning into equal RTL/NEMU blocks, then a restored comparison. All eleven labels appear correctly, routing does not feed one model into the other, and labels are large and uncut. The upper/lower composition differs materially from the old side-by-side chip/document illustration.
review.limitations: This is the root reviewer's acceptance of a design candidate, not user approval. The image uses fairly bold type and borders and mild tonal shading; raster letters have no exact font-point metadata. Numerical startup identity and historical test counts remain in the caption.

recommended_caption: 启动输入统一与差分恢复
